summary: Ritsumeikan University Kentaro Kaneko Laboratory conducts collaborative research focused on developing new materials and applications relevant to the semiconductor industry. Their projects include low-cost hydrogen production technology and germanium dioxide power semiconductors, showcasing their innovative contributions to the field.
